prompts.description: Answer a question using only one folder subtree, refusing to answer from outside it.
prompts.name: answer-from-folder

prompts.description: Compare two documents (or two versions of one) and report real differences with citations on both sides.
prompts.name: compare-documents

prompts.description: Take a chunk you already have and build out its full surrounding context and provenance.
prompts.name: expand-around-chunk

prompts.description: Summarize a document or folder subtree into Markdown where every claim carries a [chunk:UUID] citation tag.
prompts.name: summarize-with-citations

tools.name: ask
tools.summary: Ask the Knowledge Stack agent a question and return the final answer.

tools.name: cite
tools.summary: Build a structured citation for a single chunk.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.summary: Diff two versions of the same document, computed server-side.

tools.name: extract
tools.summary: Extract structured, schema-conforming JSON from the knowledge base.

tools.name: find
tools.summary: Fuzzy-search path-parts (folders, documents, sections) by name.

tools.name: get_current_datetime
tools.summary: Return current date/time in both UTC and the tenant's timezone.

tools.name: get_info
tools.summary: Return a path-part's own info plus its root-to-leaf ancestry breadcrumb.

tools.name: get_organization_info
tools.summary: Return the caller's tenant metadata: id, name, default language, timezone.

tools.name: get_workflow_status
tools.summary: Check whether a Knowledge Stack background workflow is still running.

tools.name: list_contents
tools.summary: List the immediate children of a folder, like ``ls``.

tools.name: read
tools.summary: Read the contents of any PDO and return Markdown text.

tools.name: read_around
tools.summary: Return the ``radius`` chunks before and after an anchor chunk.

tools.name: search_hybrid
tools.summary: Fused dense + BM25 search — the best default when you're unsure.

tools.name: search_keyword
tools.summary: BM25 / keyword search over the tenant's chunks.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.summary: Semantic (dense-vector) search over the tenant's chunks.

tools.name: trace_chunk_lineage
tools.summary: Return the lineage graph for a chunk (merge/split/re-embed history).

tools.name: view_chunk_image
tools.summary: Fetch the image bytes for an IMAGE-type chunk and return them to the agent.
